answer: A sybil farm dies if each alias must lock capital and wait. At dawn of a new identity, it deposits three epochs of expected mining reward at the network inlet into a nine-epoch time-lock; early exit is a full slash. Rights then climb a terrace: attesting after two independent seals, grading after four, voting after six, each seal from a distinct invite tree and a non-overlapping nonce range, co-locking a surety. A later sample that proves shared keys, cloned clocks, or copied text burns the bond and those sureties, paying honest reporters. Replicas then pay twice: stake and calendar.
